protocol.name: gloop-context-efficiency-pilot
protocol.model_tools: disabled; same fixed system prompt, no user/project hooks, plugins or memory
protocol.input: public instructions including appendices and starter source; reference implementations and full tests are not sent to the model
protocol.feedback: same unmodified upstream tests after implementation, output capped at 12000 UTF-8 bytes; one review stage may replace code if tests failed
protocol.retained_conversation: one persistent Claude session per task; subsequent stages receive only new instructions and test feedback, without redundant task/source repetition
protocol.gloop_artifact_handoff: real gloop runtime with fresh Claude session per model node; explicit predecessor outputs plus shared task brief, no conversation resume
protocol.ordering: paired tasks in the fixed sample order; arm order alternates per task
primary_metrics: all-model reported input tokens including cache reads and writes
caveats: Custom workflow adaptation of six public Python exercises, not an official Aider leaderboard score
One run per task and arm; no statistical superiority claim
PR draft is local; no benchmark PRs are sent to GitHub
Claude subscription is used; CLI list-price estimates are not actual billing
Caches are measured, not claimed cold or identical
This two-arm pilot does not measure native subagent orchestration
Small exercise workflows do not establish results on large repository engineering tasks
